title: Round 3 / ECDLP-8: literature and exact bound for mixed character sums along EC subgroups
question: What is the exact, sourced statement of the best Weil-type bound for sums sum_{Q in E(F_p)} psi(Q) chi(g(Q)) (psi a group character of E(F_p), chi a multiplicative character, g a rational function), including constants and degree dependence, and what is known about the limiting distribution (Katz/Deligne equidistribution) of the normalized sums? Does it explain a periodogram variance below 1 for chi(x([k]P))?
rationale: Resolve reproduced anomaly from ECDLP-7 (HYP-242da418) before drawing conclusions.
success_criteria: Exact statements with verified sources or explicit unverified marks; reproducible code/seeds/outputs; never claim a DL leak without replication and controls.
resource_limit: One bounded subagent; no recursion; computations < 5 min each; no commits; ~60 min.
